headline: Rocket Lab to Acquire Iridium Following Strong Earnings Report
summary: Rocket Lab announced plans to acquire Iridium after satellite operator Iridium posted a strong quarterly earnings beat.
why: Space infrastructure and satellite communication companies are consolidating as commercial space launch and orbital data demands accelerate.

impacts.name: Iridium Communications
impacts.why: Acquisition announcements typically drive target company valuations closer to the offered transaction price.

why_moved: A merger announcement combined with positive quarterly financial results attracted significant buying interest in the equities.
